remarks: GREAT OPPORTUNITY – DIAMOND IN THE ROUGH!    Discover the potential of this Garden Grove property! This 3-bedroom home with a separate office offers a wonderful opportunity for buyers looking to add their personal touch and create something truly special. The property features a fully fenced front and backyard, providing privacy and plenty of space for outdoor enjoyment. Mature fruit trees add charm and character to the grounds. Ideally situated in Garden Grove with convenient access to Disneyland Resort, Knott's Berry Farm, Chapman University, Santa Ana College, and major medical facilities, including nearby UCI Medical Center, Garden Grove Hospital, and Children's Hospital of Orange
